variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: Variables use `var` for mutable and `const` for immutable values.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.notes: Chapel uses `real` for floating point numbers.

operators.title: Operators
operators.code:
var z = x + y;
var b = x > y;

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.notes: Conditionals use braces without parentheses for the condition.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: Chapel natively supports ranges for iteration.

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Procedures (functions) are declared using the `proc` keyword.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.notes: Arrays are defined by domain mappings (e.g., ranges).

maps.title: Maps

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: Chapel uses C-style // single-line and /* */ multi-line comments.

numbers.title: Numbers & Numerics
numbers.notes: Chapel provides explicitly sized integer and floating-point primitives with binary and hex support.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: Chapel uses bool / boolean types with true and false literals and logical operators (&&, ||, !).

type_casting.title: Type Casting & Conversion
type_casting.notes: Chapel supports explicit type casting using cast operators or constructor functions.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: Chapel distinguishes between single-character literals and string sequences or pointer slices.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: Chapel supports string interpolation or printf-style formatting specifiers.

pattern_matching.title: Pattern Matching & Switch
pattern_matching.notes: Chapel evaluates branching conditions through switch statements, match expressions, or when constructs.

range.title: Ranges & Slicing
range.notes: Chapel represents ranges with range operators (.., ..<) or standard indexed iteration boundaries.

iterators.title: Iterators & Sequences
iterators.notes: Chapel implements iteration through Iterator interfaces, generators, or range-for loops.

oop_classes.title: Classes & OOP
oop_classes.notes: Chapel models object orientation through classes with constructors/encapsulation or structs with associated methods.

lists.title: Dynamic Arrays & Lists
lists.notes: Chapel manages growable dynamic collections using vectors, ArrayLists, or dynamically reallocated heap buffers.

tuples.title: Tuples & Records
tuples.notes: Chapel represents heterogeneous records through tuples, structured bindings, or lightweight record structs.

sets.title: Sets & Unique Collections
sets.notes: Chapel provides unique collection hashing structures with O(1) average lookup and insertion time.

modules_import.title: Modules, Packages & Imports
modules_import.notes: Chapel structures namespaces and external libraries via include directives, package declarations, or module imports.
